gaps.title: Missing end-to-end manufacturing-cell evidence
gaps.rationale: Route demonstrations do not by themselves close resources, process, inspection, and recovery.

gaps.title: Feedstock/simulant transfer uncertainty
gaps.rationale: Simulant outcomes need a declared material-card and site-transfer boundary.

gaps.title: Resource coupling gap
gaps.rationale: Energy, thermal, dust, and consumable interfaces are not one secondary constraint.

gaps.title: Quality-release gap
gaps.rationale: Early locally made items need inspection, quarantine, and use-class rules.

gaps.title: Recovery-route gap
gaps.rationale: A failed route needs rework, substitute, imported spare, or deferment decisions.

gaps.title: Overbroad Mars-factory claims
gaps.rationale: Partial gravity and environmental constraints must not be collapsed into a generic factory narrative.
